thread:
Elena Park: FYI discovered surge of near-duplicate prompts after the 4bit quant bring-up this morning. labeler queue doubled and a few golden anchors flagged as contested.

Sam Torres: can you paste an example? sounds like tokenizer mismatch or normalization drift.

Elena Park: small sample attached below (scrubbed). variants differ only by punctuation + unicode normalization:
```
orig: "How do I reset my password?"
variant A: "How do I reset my password? \u2014"
variant B: "How do I reset my password?\n"
variant C: "How do I reset my password? \n"
```
hash(orig) != hash(variant) because fingerprinting uses raw tokens pre-normalize.

Ravi Patel: that's the ingestion pipeline issue. we recently switched embed fingerprint model from embed-v1 -> embed-v3 but forgot to run the text normalizer in the ingest lambda. so embeddings diverge and dedupe misses.

Asha Menon: immediate mitigations: 1) stop new harvests from web-scrape-v3 2) trigger reindex for last 72h 3) run microgolden + contested triage for anchors touched by reindex.

Elena Park: enacted stop: @deploy-bot stop harvest:web-scrape-v3 (task 87654).

deploy-bot: (bot) acknowledged. harvest:web-scrape-v3 stopped by Elena Park. task=87654

labeler-bot: (bot) flagged 1,210 duplicated-ish items based on relaxed fuzzy match. suggested command: `microgolden-create --candidates s3://redwood/temp/reindex/4795559999/candidates.csv --size 1500 --consensus 3 --tag reindex-dedupe`

Sam Torres: for reindex we should use `reindex-fingerprints --model embed-v3 --normalize unicode-nfkc --strip-whitespace --window 72h` so new fingerprints match the current embed model pipeline.

Ravi Patel: agree. also add `--tokenizer-version 2.1.0` to match the runtime used for quant4b tests. failing that we risk reintroducing duplicates after reingest.

Asha Menon: owners: @Ravi runs reindex + normalizer patch, @Elena runs microgolden triage, @Sam coordinates labeler overflow.

Sam Torres: copying in temporary contractors from growth if queue > 800 after microgolden. currently labeler capacity=420 active reviewers.

Elena Park: creating microgolden set now. running: `microgolden-refresh --source s3://redwood/temp/reindex/4795559999/candidates.csv --size 1500 --consensus 3` ETA ~1.5h.

Ravi Patel: kicked off reindex job: job_id=ri-4795559999, started at 07:24 UTC. logs -> s3://redwood/logs/reindex/ri-4795559999.log. expected finish ~40m.

labeler-bot: (bot) reindex preview: duplicate_groups_found=634, potential_golden_conflicts=27, contested_candidates=412

Elena Park: before we finalize dedupe, we need to run a quick regression check. plan: sample 250 existing golden anchors vs post-dedupe candidates, run eval harness `eval-harness --suite promptset-stable --metrics accuracy,acceptance_rate --model quant4b-lite-canary`

Sam Torres: I'll spin a staging canary: @deploy-bot open canary quant4b-lite-canary /canary/quant4b-lite-4795559999

deploy-bot: (bot) canary opened at /canary/quant4b-lite-4795559999, route=staging, owner=Sam Torres

Ravi Patel: reindex job finished. summarized: reindexed=72,300 samples, reconciled_duplicates=9,420, updated_fingerprints=68,880. detailed CSV -> s3://redwood/temp/reindex/4795559999/reconciled.csv

Elena Park: microgolden completed. consensus_labels_ready=1,500; contested_after_consensus=39. uploaded labels -> s3://redwood/temp/reindex/4795559999/microgolden_labels.csv

Sam Torres: running eval harness now against canary. will post results in ~25m.

labeler-bot: (bot) summary after dedupe: queue_length=490 (down from 970), duplicate_rate=9.6%, golden_conflicts=21

Sam Torres: eval results: accuracy delta = -0.6%, acceptance_rate delta = -0.2% vs baseline. both within tolerance. raw -> s3://redwood/evals/4795559999/quant4b-lite-canary.json

Asha Menon: sounds acceptable. recommended next steps: 1) resume harvest with patched normalizer 2) backfill reindexed fingerprints for last 7 days 3) schedule follow-up golden sweep in 48h.

Ravi Patel: patched ingest lambda and deployed v2.1.0-normalizer. deployment id dl-9901. will monitor for any new divergence.

Elena Park: resuming harvest now. @deploy-bot start harvest:web-scrape-v3 (task 87655)

deploy-bot: (bot) acknowledged. harvest:web-scrape-v3 started by Elena Park. task=87655

Sam Torres: closing loop: archived audit CSV -> s3://redwood/triage/4795559999/dupes_audit.csv. tagging for postmortem if > 0.75% golden delta in next 48h.

Elena Park: thanks team. if labeler backlog spikes again I'll trigger temporary contract help. :white_check_mark:
